links.outcome: GPT-4 biopsy recommendation accuracy against histopathology ground truth and expert-rated report accuracy
links.effect: 20.8% (190/912) of SOI patients could avoid unnecessary biopsies with GPT-4; more than 90.0% of reports comprehensive and easy to understand, but accuracy rated satisfactory in only 82.8%.
links.quote: With the assistance of GPT-4, 20.8% (190/912) of the SOI population could avoid unnecessary biopsies, and it performed even better [28.8% (118/410)] in the most heterogeneous subgroup of PI-RADS score 3.

unlisted_practices: Chain-of-Thought prompting to expose the LLM's decision-making logic
Structured prompt-generated reports for biopsy decision support

screen.reason: The study evaluates the diagnostic decision-making performance of GPT-4 on retrospective multicenter clinical/MRI data for prostate biopsy decisions without testing specific deployment safeguards.
